build.name: Pick Hoarder
build.about: An outsized share of value sits in draft picks.
plan: Picks lose value as the draft nears unless they're early; know which ones to use and which to flip.
Turn late firsts into young players who already produce.
Package several picks to move up for a top-three pick in a strong class.
reasons: 11th of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (108.8)
55% of player value is 24 or younger (3rd most)

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut
build.about: Strong now and strong later: top-third points and top-third dynasty value without an old core.
plan: Win now without spending the future: trade depth and later picks for upgrades, not young starters.
Sell any starter about to age out a year early while he still has value.
Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.
reasons: 1st of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (197.8)

build.name: Stuck in the Middle
build.about: Not good enough to win, not young enough to wait, and the record is outside the playoff line.
